items.headline: Williams' 3 passing TDs and Jones' kickoff-return TD send Tulsa over East Texas A&M 42-0
items.description: — Dexter Williams II threw for 164 yards and three touchdowns, Trequan Jones had a 98-yard kickoff return touchdown, and Tulsa rolled past East Texas A&M 42-0 on Saturday.

items.headline: Tulsa uses big plays from Jones, Lawyer to rally for 23-17 win over Sam Houston
items.description: — Trequan Jones ran for 125 yards and scored twice, Tulsa took the lead for good early in the third quarter and went the Golden Hurricane went on to beat Sam Houston 23-17 on Saturday.
